# Project instructions

- After code changes, add, update, or fix the related unit tests and run the
  relevant tests.
- Verify that the Flutter app compiles and builds after code changes.
- Do not launch or execute the app, start an emulator, or perform hot reloads or
  hot restarts. The user runs the app to debug and verify it in the emulator.
  Test runners and build commands are allowed.
- Before adding or editing widgets, read the relevant rules in the
  [UI design document](../design/stitch/vivid-flutter-color-palette-ui.md) and
  ensure the implementation follows its colors, borders, typography, spacing,
  shapes, styles, responsive behavior, and component states.
- If a design rule is missing, ambiguous, or conflicts with the requested UI or
  implementation, notify the user and review it with them before proceeding
  with the affected design decision. Do not invent rules or change the design
  document merely to justify an implementation.
